definitions: The fifth emperor of the Qing dynasty and the fourth Qing emperor to rule over China proper, reigning from 1735 to 1796.
A highly influential figure in Chinese history, known for expanding the empire to its greatest territorial extent and for a period of cultural and economic prosperity.
examples: Emperor Qianlong's reign saw significant advancements in art and literature.
The British embassy to Emperor Qianlong in 1793, led by Lord Macartney, failed to establish diplomatic relations.
Many valuable artifacts from the Qing dynasty date back to the time of Emperor Qianlong.
